lyrics:
[Intro: bright highlife guitar line, shaker, log drum]

[Verse 1: joyful female voice, lilting]
I came to the river and the bridge was built
Came to the table and the cup was filled
Came to the door I was scared to try
Open already, with a light inside

[Chorus: group voices, call and response, dancing]
Somebody's been here (been here before me)
Somebody's been here (clearing the road)
I didn't see you, I didn't hear you
But I know your work when I see it, oh
Every place I'm going, you already know
Somebody's been here

[Verse 2: male voice, same lilt]
I came to the grave I was sure would win
Stone rolled back and nobody in
Folded cloth where the body lay
And a gardener asking why I cry today

[Pre-Chorus: both voices, rising]
It was you, it was you, all along
Jesus, going on ahead of me, making it home

[Chorus: group voices, call and response, dancing]
Somebody's been here (been here before me)
Somebody's been here (clearing the road)
I didn't see you, I didn't hear you
But I know your work when I see it, oh
Every place I'm going, you already know
Somebody's been here

[Bridge: drums and voices, chant, building]
Night shift, day shift, you don't sleep
While I was resting, you were up for me
Ahead of me (Jesus), behind me (Jesus)
Beside me (Jesus), inside me (Jesus)

[Final Chorus: everyone, guitars dancing on top]
Somebody's been here (been here before me)
Somebody's been here (clearing the road)
I didn't see you, I didn't hear you
But I know your work when I see it, oh
Every place I'm going, you already know
Somebody's been here

[Outro: guitar line, laughter, shaker]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 104 BPM, 4/4, G major. A sunny, rolling West African pop groove that makes people sway.

VOICE: A woman leads verse 1, bright and smiling; a man with a warm tenor leads verse 2. A group sings the answers in parentheses and the choruses, in the open harmonies of African church choirs. The bridge is a chant over drums.

INSTRUMENTS: Two interlocking clean electric guitars playing highlife lines, shaker, log drum and congas, a soft kick on every beat, a singing bass guitar, a bright keyboard, handclaps.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar line. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Chorus 1. 1:06 Verse 2, the grave. 1:30 Pre-chorus, the name. 1:40 Chorus 2. 2:10 Bridge, chant. 2:34 Final chorus. 3:04 Outro, guitar and laughter, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Modern Afropop with highlife guitars: clean, warm, percussion wide, voices close and joyful.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The four-way chant 'ahead of me, behind me, beside me, inside me' at 2:22.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 is a run of good surprises. Verse 2 at 1:06 is Easter morning in John 20, with the folded cloth and the man mistaken for a gardener, and the pre-chorus names him.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Surprised, grateful, astonished, dancing.
